verdict.rationale: Bento documents a public API with authentication (HTTP Basic with pub/secret keys), endpoint reference, error-handling guide, and coverage across subscribers, events, broadcasts, transactional email, webhooks, data deletion, and chat support—plus SDKs, a 50+ command CLI, and an MCP server explicitly built for AI-native/agentic use. Missing for 10: a public OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe found all candidate paths 404) and independent third-party corroboration of API robustness beyond vendor docs.
